scenes.headline: How SANA-Video 2.0 keeps video attention mostly linear
scenes.sub: NVIDIA's hybrid backbone for 720p video on a single GPU.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lagoon! Video models drown in tokens, and softmax attention costs the square of them. Here's how SANA-Video 2.0 walks around that wall.

scenes.text: Keep three of every four attention layers linear, make the fourth a full softmax anchor, and carry the anchors' work forward with attention residuals.
scenes.say: Keep three of every four attention layers linear. Make the fourth a full softmax anchor. And carry the anchors' work forward with attention residuals.

scenes.title: From clip to tokens to transformer

steps.say: First, a high-compression VAE shrinks the clip thirty-two times on each side, and eight times in time. Five seconds of 720p becomes about ten thousand tokens.
A diffusion transformer denoises those tokens, reading the prompt from Gemma through cross-attention at every layer.

steps.note: full softmax: cost grows with the square of the tokens
steps.say: With full softmax attention in every layer, doubling the length or resolution would quadruple the attention bill.

scenes.title: The hybrid backbone, one stretch at a time

steps.say: Three gated linear layers mix tokens cheaply. Each squeezes the past into a fixed-size state, which can't hold every token-to-token interaction.

steps.note: one layer in four is full softmax
steps.say: So every fourth layer is a gated softmax anchor, restoring the exact interactions the linear layers miss.
Block attention residuals route each finished block's summary into later linear layers, so the anchors' refreshed features don't fade with depth.

scenes.title: DiT forward speedup over a full-softmax model, 720p
scenes.say: The gap widens exactly where video is expensive. Against a matched full-softmax model, the forward pass is one point five five times faster at five seconds, and three point two at sixty.

scenes.text: Spend quadratic attention only where it pays: one anchor in four, fed by a VAE that keeps the token count modest.

recap: A VAE shrinks the clip to modest tokens
Three linear layers for every softmax anchor
Residuals carry the anchors' work across depth
scenes.say: To recap: compress the clip hard, keep most layers linear, and let a few anchors and residuals keep the picture sharp.
